Title: How to Fix Not Enough Free Space to Download the Data on Nintendo Switch
IntroLines: Getting the "not enough free space to download the data" error on your Nintendo Switch?
In this video, I'll show you 3 quick ways to free up gigabytes of storage without losing your save data.

Sections.Heading: SOLUTION 1: QUICK ARCHIVE UNPLAYED GAMES
Steps: •  First, go to your home screen.
•  Move down and select **" System Settings "** .
•  Scroll down the left sidebar and select **" Data Management "** .
•  Select **" Quick Archive "** on the right side.
•  Check the box next to any games you are not currently playing.
•  Review the total free space that will be created at the bottom of the screen.
•  Select **" Archive Data "** .
•  Select **" Archive "** to confirm.
•  Finally, return to your home screen and check if your download starts normally.
Sections.Bridge: If you want to keep all your games installed, let's move data to your microSD card.

Sections.Heading: SOLUTION 2: MOVE DATA TO YOUR MICROSD CARD
Steps: •  First, open **" System Settings "** from your home screen.
•  Scroll down on the left and select **" Data Management "** .
•  Select **" Move Data Between System / microSD Card "** .
•  Select **" Move to microSD Card "** .
•  Choose the game or downloadable content you want to transfer.
•  Select **" Move "** .
•  Select **" Move Data "** to start the transfer.
•  Wait a few moments for the data transfer to complete.
•  Finally, check that your system memory now has enough free space available.
Sections.Bridge: If you still don't have enough room, let's clear out large captured videos and screenshots.

Sections.Heading: SOLUTION 3: DELETE CAPTURED SCREENSHOTS AND VIDEOS
Steps: •  First, return to your home screen.
•  Open the **" Album "** app from the bottom toolbar.
•  Select **" Filter "** on the right or press the **" Y "** button on your controller.
•  Select **" Media Type "** .
•  Choose **" Videos Only "** to locate your largest capture files.
•  Press the **" X "** button on your controller to open the manage menu.
•  Select **" Delete Multiple Items "** .
•  Select the video clips you no longer need.
•  Select **" Delete Selected Items "** .
•  Confirm by selecting **" Delete "** .
•  Finally, resume your download from the home screen.

OutroLines: And that's how you can fix not enough free space to download data on your Nintendo Switch.
